violations.text: Ceiling tile missing. Above range hood ventilation.

Basic - Establishment charging operational charges without properly disclosing the information on the menu/web/app and the bill/receipt. New Florida law requires operator to inform guest of operational credit card fee prior to ordering, not on menus. Gave operator flyer.
Old labels stuck to food containers after cleaning. Clean bins with old labels on drying rack, moved to wash.
Wet wiping cloths used for occasional spills on equipment food- and nonfood-contact surfaces not clean. Operator moved to dirty laundry.

Employee touching ready-to-eat food with their bare hands - food was not being heated as a sole ingredient to 145 degrees F or immediately added to other ingredients to be cooked/heated to the minimum required temperature to allow bare hand contact. Establishment has no approved Alternative Operating Procedure. Server loaded bread for toast with bare hands, educated server and she discarded. Use of tongs implemented.
Ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food marked with a date that exceeds 7 days after opening/preparation. Chicken salad in make table dated 9-19, operator discarded.
Vacuum breaker missing at mop sink faucet or on fitting/splitter added to mop sink faucet.

No proof provided that food employees are informed of their responsibility to report to the person in charge information about their health and activities related to foodborne illnesses. Matthew hired two weeks ago had not signed, provided to operator.
